Admission

Students from the five year programmes shall have passed at least 120 credits, including two second-cycle (A) courses within the subject area. Students from the international master programmes shall have passed 45 credits, including two second-cycle (A) courses within the subject area.

The number of participants is limited to: No

Scientific papers or other literature related to the chosen topic.
